per_question.question: Why doesn't material wealth provide lasting happiness?

hits.title: 3 प्रकार के कर्मों का रहस्य - कैसे मिलेगी जीवन-मरण से छुट्टी? Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Pravachan

answer.answer: Material wealth does not provide lasting happiness because desires keep increasing endlessly; when one desire is fulfilled, another, bigger desire arises, creating a cycle of craving without satisfaction. For example, a person who was once a millionaire starts wanting to become a billionaire, and even billionaires want to surpass others, showing that material gains never bring true contentment. Additionally, even if one accumulates vast wealth, it is temporary and can be exhausted, like money in a bank that eventually runs out if spent without earning more. Moreover, worldly pleasures and comforts are transient and cannot provide real bliss, as people remain restless and unhappy despite their possessions [1][3][4][8].

answer.answer: भौतिक धन से स्थायी सुख इसलिए नहीं मिलता क्योंकि जब एक कामना पूरी हो जाती है, तो दुगनी कामना उत्पन्न हो जाती है। उदाहरण के लिए, यदि कोई व्यक्ति लाखपति होता है, तो वह करोड़पति बनने की इच्छा करता है, और करोड़पति बनने के बाद अरबपति बनने की लालसा होती है। इस प्रकार, कामनाओं की यह बढ़ती हुई श्रृंखला कभी खत्म नहीं होती, जिससे स्थायी सुख प्राप्त नहीं हो पाता। इसके अलावा, भौतिक सुखों में भी दुख, बीमारी और असंतोष होते हैं, जैसे कि देवताओं के लोक में भी सुख नहीं है और वहाँ भी बीमारी होती है। इसलिए, भौतिक धन से आनंद नहीं मिलता और स्थायी सुख की प्राप्ति नहीं होती है[2][1].

3 प्रकार के कर्मों का रहस्य - कैसे मिलेगी जीवन-मरण से छुट्टी? Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Pravachan

answer.answer:
Paisa aur dhan se permanent sukh isliye nahi milta kyunki jab ek ichha puri ho jati hai to dusri ichha utpann ho jati hai, aur yeh chakkar lagataar chalta rehta hai. Jaise agar koi lakhpati tha to ab crore pati banne ki ichha hoti hai, aur crore pati banne ke baad arabpati banne ki ichha hoti hai. Is tarah paisa badhne ke saath ichha bhi badhti hai, jisse sukh nahi milta balki dukh hi dukh hota hai. Isliye paisa aur dhan se sukh sthayi nahi hota kyunki ichhaon ka ant nahi hota aur sukh milne ke baad bhi man ko shanti nahi milti [1][6].

Iske alawa, dhan ki seema hoti hai; agar koi aadmi ek crore jama kar le aur kharch karna band kar de to kuch samay baad paisa khatam ho jata hai. Is prakar dhan ki kamai bhi seemit hai aur usse milne wala sukh bhi sthayi nahi hota [4][5].

answer.answer: Devotion should begin in childhood because it helps one avoid attachment to worldly work and distractions. As illustrated by the example of Prahlad, even while doing necessary work, one should not develop attachment to it but rather focus on devotion to God from an early age. This early devotion helps maintain spiritual focus despite life's demands and distractions, which are common for people of all ages and statuses, including businessmen and service workers [1][3]. Starting devotion early ensures that the mind remains connected to God rather than getting lost in worldly attachments and acting mechanically in relationships and duties [6][8].

Bhakti bachpan se hi shuru karni chahiye kyunki chhoti aayu mein hi Bhagwan mein lag jao, baki kaam bhi karo, lekin kaam mein man ka attachment na karo. Prahlad ne bhi kaha tha ki chhoti aayu mein hi bhakti karni chahiye, taaki man bhakti mein laga rahe aur kaam ke saath man ka attachment na ho[2].

Iske alawa, jeevan mein vyavaharik kaam karte hue bhi man ko bhakti mein lagana chahiye, tabhi jeevan ka sahi upyog hota hai aur bhagwan ki or lagav badhta hai[4][6].
